achieved.note: Tested on expanded 73-case suite including 16 new edge cases (March 20, 2026)

category_classification: Added 'wireless receiver' + 'receiver' to hardware peripheral keywords
Added peripheral-disconnect keywords (e.g. 'mouse keeps disconnecting': 6.0) to prevent network over-classification of hardware peripheral issues
Added 'battery is dead' / 'battery dead' as hardware keywords
Added hardware phrases: wireless receiver, battery is dead, spilled, liquid damage, server down, server is down, server has been down
Added software phrases: printer software, printer driver, software install, driver install, software won't install — fixes printer-software tickets being classified as hardware
priority_classification: Reduced 'broken' weight HIGH 4.0 → 2.5 — prevented 'screen broken' and similar from incorrectly reaching HIGH
Added 'locked out' (5.0), 'account locked' (5.0), 'account is locked' (5.0) to HIGH — fixes account lockout tickets scoring as MEDIUM
Added 'password expired' (4.5) to HIGH — blocks all system access
Added 'not responding' (4.0), 'won't respond' (4.0) to HIGH — fixes frozen-app tickets scoring as MEDIUM
Added 'update failed' (4.0), 'failed to update' (4.0), 'system won't restart' (4.5) to HIGH
Added 'keeps crashing' (5.0), 'keeps restarting' (5.0) to HIGH — repeated crash loop is HIGH
Added 'remote access not working' (4.5) to HIGH
Added MFA failure keywords: 'mfa not working', '2fa not working', 'authenticator not working', 'authentication stopped working' (all 4.5) to HIGH
Added deadline-driven urgency: 'in 30 minutes' (5.0), 'in an hour' (4.5), 'presentation in' (4.0) to HIGH
Added 'no one can work' (5.0) to HIGH business_impact
Reduced 'blocking' weight HIGH 4.5 → 2.5; added 'blocking my work' (5.0) for precise matching
Reduced 'need' weight MEDIUM 2.5 → 1.0 and 'help' 2.0 → 0.5 — prevents generic vague requests from scoring MEDIUM
Added performance LOW keywords: slow, running slow, buffering, optimizing — fixes performance-only tickets scoring MEDIUM
feature_engineering: Subject-line weighting: subject text prepended twice (2x weight) in classifier.py classify() method via combined_text = subject + subject + description
Subject-line weighting propagated to feature_extractor.py fit() and transform() for ML model retraining
Expanded URGENCY_KEYWORDS in feature_extractor.py: added locked out, account locked, password expired, MFA failures, deadline-urgency, repeated failure patterns
New 'technical' urgency keywords: driver, firmware, registry, event log
test_suite: Added 16 new edge-case test scenarios targeting ambiguous/multi-topic tickets
New test categories: subject-line weighted tests (3), negation/contradiction patterns (2), deadline-urgency (3), multi-topic root-cause tests (3), onboarding multi-need (1)
Total test cases increased from 57 to 73
Added subject field support in AccuracyTester.run_test() — passes subject to classifier
Accuracy success threshold raised from 70% to 87% to reflect improved capability
Added ACCURACY_TARGETS constant documenting baseline, weaknesses, and sprint targets

known_limitations: Keyword matching is order-sensitive for multi-word phrases; 'battery is dead' and 'dead battery' are tracked as separate keywords
Negation handling is not implemented — 'no hardware issues' still matches hardware keywords
Tickets mixing network and hardware causes close score ties; peripheral-disconnect heuristic is the primary tie-breaker
Short single-word tickets have low confidence and may fall back to 'other'
Subject-line weighting is additive; very long descriptions can still overpower short subjects
notes: Classifier type: rule-based weighted keyword matching (TicketClassifier in src/classifier.py)
ML model (MLCategoryClassifier) requires retrain to incorporate feature_extractor.py subject weighting
Milestone feedback: classification edge cases on ambiguous/multi-topic tickets addressed in this version
Next steps: implement negation detection, expand phrase library, retrain ML model on expanded training set
